flavor.phonemic_palette: Egyptian backbone (dj, tj, kh, h, sh, q; l->r; v->w; endings -aa/-et) with Ge'ez overlay touches (-a endings, amba/debr, emphatics); theophoric stems are second-order morphs of the Punic forms (Tjulraa-, Argandja-, Warlandja-, Riarath-).
flavor.phenotype_notes: Synthesis of Egyptian + Ethiopian per setting-lore §5.3 (blend the listed features; exclude the inverse).

magic_attitude.notes: Egyptian + Ethiopian register; deity-morphs in name_bank 'kemeti'.

religion_hooks.alignment_lens: Resolved per the culture's chosen alignment (setting-lore §4.2): Lawful venerates the 12 Lawful powers and names the 13 as demons; Chaotic venerates the 13 and names the 12 as tyrant-gods; Neutral venerates this culture's ancestral saints, invoking the great gods only situationally.

flavor_text.one_line: Kemeti — tolerant theocratic of the desert; piety, tradition.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Kemeti (Egyptian + Ethiopian) are a assertive theocratic people seeded in desert, savanna, hills. They prize piety, tradition, wealth, lean toward the religious sphere, and field archers, heavy_infantry, war_elephants. Outsiders are met as tolerant; their patrons touch trade, death, light.
